what: Plan adds a harness pre-write fetch gate but never retires today’s inline baseline loop (`run_list_successful` plus per-run `_collect_log_rows`)
scenario_or_breakage: `--kind harness` or `all` can fetch and parse the same CI logs twice, or the old loop and the new gate can diverge on skip-on-failed-log semantics
suggested_fix: After `ci_timing_fetch` lands, route every harness baseline read through `harness_ci_timing.fetch_timing_rows` and keep `_collect_log_rows` only for per-run verification logs (or one shared helper used by both)
